<?php

$baseUrl = 'https://api.spryng.nl/v2/webhooks/subscriptions';
$ch = curl_init();
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $baseUrl);

$headers = [
     'AccountReference' => 'your-AccountReference-header-here',
     'X-Api-Key' => 'YOUR_KEY_HERE'
    ];

curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);


    $body = json_encode([
  [
    "eventType" => "eventType",
    "callbacks" => [
      [
        "url" => "url",
        "platform" => "platform",
        "optionalNotes" => "optionalNotes"
      ]
    ],
    "requiresAuthentication" => false,
    "contactEmail" => "contactEmail"
  ]
]);
        
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);

$response = curl_exec($ch);
$info = curl_getinfo($ch);

curl_close($ch);

if ($info['http_code'] >= 400) {
    echo 'Error! HTTP code: ' . $info['http_code'] . ', Response: ' . $response;
} else {
    echo 'Success! Response: ' . $response;
}

sections.title: API overview
sections.content:
This endpoint allows for the creation of a new webhook event subscription.

Webhooks are automated messages sent from our applications when something happens (an event occurs) and received to any valid public URL or application* included in your request. This event-triggered communication allows for near real-time data sharing, providing instant updates on message statuses and more. You must create a new webhook for each event you would like to subscribe to or receive updates on.

A full list of available events is listed below. Please see the other documentation pages in the Webhooks section of this site for further information on possible webhook actions. Spryng has multiple options for additional security and webhook authentication. Please see our Webhook Authentication page for more information.

Note: *the receiving service must be a publicly accessible web page or web service which you host.

sections.title: Headers
sections.content:
These parameters are mandatory to be provided in the header of your request. If not provided, or incorrect, your request will fail.

HeaderTypeDescription
ContentTypeStringapplication/json
X-Api-KeyStringAPI Key value for authorization
AccountReferenceStringYour Esendex account reference - e.g. SPNL0000000


Example request header:
POST https://api.spryng.nl/v2/webhooks/subscriptions
-H 'Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'
-H 'AccountReference: SPNL0000000'
-H 'Content-Type: application/json'

sections.title: Request body
sections.content:
You can use the cURL sample provided on the right hand side of this page to directly copy/paste into your chosen integration tool, using the below properties to modify your request as required for your business needs.

Required request body parameters

If a required parameter is not provided, or incorrect, the request will fail. If a parameter is conditional, it is only required for certain channels or is dependent on the desired format of the message.

ParameterTypeDescription
eventTypeStringThe name of the available event you want to subscribe to.See a full list of available events below
callbacksArrayContains an array of one or more URLs where you would like the information to be received
urlStringSub-property of "callbacks". Include a new "url" property and input field line within your request body for each URL you would like to receive information to. This must be a publicly accessible web page or service which you host


Request body example
{
  {
    "eventType": "sms-message-failed",
    "callbacks": [
      {
        "url": "https://manual-test.com"
      }
    ]
  },
    {
    "eventType": "sms-message-delivered",
    "callbacks": [
      {
        "url": "https://manual-test.com"
      }
    ]
  }
}

sections.title: Available events
sections.content:
There are multiple available events which can be subscribed to via our v2/webhooks. You can complete a GET v2/webhooks/events request to retrieve a full list of available events for your account, or refer to the below list.

Available webhook events

eventIdDescription
sms-message-deliveredReceive updates for delivered messages. Updates will be received whenever the message-delivered event is triggered for requests associated to your account
sms-message-failedReceive updates on failed messages. Updates will be received whenever the message-failed event is triggered for requests associated to your account
sms-message-receivedReceive updates when an Inbound message has been received for any requests associated to your account
sms-inbound-opted-outReceive updates when a customer has requested to opt out and stop receiving messages from your account. Updates will be received whenever the inbound-opted-out event is triggered for any request associated to your account

sections.title: Responses
sections.content:
The standard responses for this API are listed below. For a full list of possible REST API status codes, please refer to this guide.

Success
201 Created
Success response with empty body

Error codes
400 Bad Request
The server could not understand the request due to incorrect syntax or an incorrect/missing required property aka missing or incorrect account reference provided. You should not repeat the request without modifications.
{
    "errors": [
        {
            "errorCode": "webhook_subscription_not_found",
            "errorMessage": "Webhook subscription not found for this account and this event type"
        }
    ]
}

401 Unauthorized
Indicates that the request has failed due to missing or incorrect authentication information. You can repeat the request with a suitable authorization header field.
{
    "errors": [
        {
            "errorCode": "unauthenticatedError",
            "errorMessage": "Request for authenticated route '/v2/webhooks/subscriptions' was unauthenticated"
        }
    ]
}
